blocks.zh: 附錄5：案例研究——2000L單次使用生物反應器
blocks.en: Appendix 5: Case Study - 2000 L Single-Use Bioreactor

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Chapter

blocks.zh: 掌握 2000L 規模 SUB（單次使用生物反應器）的技術選型流程——包括定性評估、定量評估（混合時間、kLa、CO₂去除、細胞性能）以及加權評分決策方法
blocks.en: Understand the technology selection process for a 2000 L-scale SUB (single-use bioreactor), including qualitative assessment, quantitative assessment (blend time, kLa, CO₂ stripping, cell performance) and the weighted-scoring decision method

blocks.zh: 了解在既有 GMP 設施中安裝大型 SUB 的工程挑戰，包括空間限制、建設通道管理、不鏽鋼與一次性系統的混合設計策略
blocks.en: Understand the engineering challenges of installing a large SUB in an existing GMP facility, including space constraints, construction access management, and the hybrid design strategy combining stainless steel and single-use systems

blocks.zh: 理解轉換至一次性技術所引入的新風險（洩漏、供應鏈依賴、庫存管理）及其緩解措施（FMEA、訓練批次、流程圖）
blocks.en: Understand the new risks introduced by the move to single-use technology (leaks, supply chain dependency, inventory management) and their mitigations (FMEA, training batches, process flow map)

blocks.zh: 學習如何透過兩階段翻新專案系統性地累積與應用經驗教訓（AAR），將溝通、文件和安裝問題量化後落實改善
blocks.en: Learn how a two-phase renovation project can systematically capture and apply lessons learned (AAR), quantifying communication, documentation and installation issues and acting on them

blocks.zh: 建立大型生物製程 CDMO 導入 SUB 平台的決策框架：從供應商評選、設施改造、確效到供應鏈管理的完整視角
blocks.en: Build a decision framework for adopting an SUB platform at a large-scale biologics CDMO: a complete view from vendor selection and facility modification to validation and supply chain management

blocks.zh: 9.1 Summary（摘要）
blocks.en: 9.1 Summary

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：2000L SUB 導入的策略背景
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Strategic Background to Adopting a 2000 L SUB

blocks.zh: GSK Upper Merion 這個案例代表了業界由不鏽鋼（SS）向一次性技術（SUT）轉型的典型里程碑。2000L 規模在當時（2018年前後）是商業化 SUB 的技術邊界——比 1000L 的中試規模更大，但又尚未達到傳統 10,000–20,000L 不鏽鋼發酵槽的規模。
blocks.en: The GSK Upper Merion case represents a typical industry milestone in the shift from stainless steel (SS) to single-use technology (SUT). At the time (around 2018), 2000 L was the technical boundary for commercial SUBs: larger than the 1000 L pilot scale, but not yet at the scale of traditional 10,000–20,000 L stainless steel fermenters.

blocks.zh: Scale-out（橫向擴展）策略的核心邏輯：與其使用一台超大型反應器（scale-up），不如複製多台 2000L SUB，降低批次失敗風險、提高排程靈活性。
blocks.en: The core logic of the scale-out strategy: rather than using one very large bioreactor (scale-up), replicate several 2000 L SUBs, which lowers the risk of batch failure and improves scheduling flexibility.

blocks.zh: 分兩階段執行是重要的風險管理決策——先在 Suite 1 試點，學習後再改造 Suite 2，讓組織能「邊做邊學」而非一次全押。
blocks.en: Executing in two phases was an important risk management decision: pilot in Suite 1 first, then renovate Suite 2 once the lessons were learned, so the organization could "learn while doing" rather than bet everything at once.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你要把公司的電話系統從傳統固網升級為雲端 VoIP——你不會在同一天把全公司的電話都換掉（風險太高），而是先在一個部門試行，確認穩定後再推廣全公司。GSK 的兩階段 SUB 導入就是這個道理：Suite 1 是試驗田，Suite 2 是收成田。
blocks.en: Imagine upgrading your company's phone system from traditional landlines to cloud VoIP. You would not replace every phone in the company on the same day (too risky); you would trial it in one department first and roll it out company-wide once it proved stable. GSK's two-phase SUB adoption follows the same logic: Suite 1 is the test field and Suite 2 is the harvest field.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 而言，2000L SUB 平台的戰略意義在於：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the strategic significance of a 2000 L SUB platform is:

blocks.zh: 客戶彈性：不同分子可使用相同平台，降低交叉污染風險，加速產品切換
blocks.en: Customer flexibility: different molecules can use the same platform, which reduces cross-contamination risk and speeds up product changeover

blocks.zh: 商業化橋梁：從臨床（500L）到商業化（多台 2000L）的平滑過渡，無需建新廠
blocks.en: Bridge to commercialization: a smooth transition from clinical scale (500 L) to commercial scale (multiple 2000 L units) without building a new plant

blocks.zh: 資本效率：SUB 的資本支出遠低於同規模不鏽鋼系統，適合 CDMO 的多客戶商業模式
blocks.en: Capital efficiency: the capital expenditure of an SUB is far lower than that of a stainless steel system of the same scale, which suits the multi-client business model of a CDMO

blocks.zh: 9.2 SUB Technology Selection（技術選型）
blocks.en: 9.2 SUB Technology Selection

blocks.zh: 核心概念：兩階段供應商評選架構
blocks.en: Core Concept: A Two-Stage Vendor Selection Framework

blocks.zh: GSK 採用「定性篩選 → 定量深評」的兩階段評選，這是工業界標準的供應商評估做法：
blocks.en: GSK used a two-stage selection of "qualitative screening, then quantitative in-depth evaluation", which is standard industry practice for vendor assessment:

blocks.zh: 定性篩選：快速淘汰不符合基本要求的供應商（人機工程、供應鏈能力、規模縮小代表性）
blocks.en: Qualitative screening: quickly eliminates vendors that do not meet basic requirements (ergonomics, supply chain capability, representativeness of the scale-down model)

blocks.zh: 定量深評：對入圍供應商進行可量化的工程測試，減少主觀判斷
blocks.en: Quantitative in-depth evaluation: quantifiable engineering tests on the shortlisted vendors, reducing subjective judgment

blocks.zh: 加權評分：將定性與定量結果整合成可比較的總分，確保決策透明可審查
blocks.en: Weighted scoring: combines the qualitative and quantitative results into a comparable total score, so the decision is transparent and auditable

blocks.zh: 注意：定量評估是在 non-GMP 區域進行的——這是關鍵決策。在採購前無需動用 GMP 資源，降低成本與干擾。
blocks.en: Note: the quantitative evaluation was performed in a non-GMP area. This was a key decision: no GMP resources are tied up before purchase, which lowers cost and disruption.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：供應鏈評估的特殊重要性
blocks.en: Key Point: The Special Importance of Supply Chain Assessment

blocks.zh: 定性標準中，Vendor supply chain robustness 被列為評估項目，這在 2018 年前後開始受到重視——COVID-19 疫情之後，供應鏈中斷的風險已成為 SUB 採用的頭號障礙。
blocks.en: Among the qualitative criteria, Vendor supply chain robustness was listed as an evaluation item. This began to receive attention around 2018; after COVID-19, the risk of supply chain disruption became the number one barrier to SUB adoption.

blocks.zh: 評估供應鏈時應關注：bag film 供應商是否單一？備用製造廠是否存在？輻照滅菌場地有幾個？
blocks.en: When assessing the supply chain, look at: Is there a single bag film supplier? Does a backup manufacturing site exist? How many irradiation sites are there?

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Scale-down 的重要性
blocks.en: Analogy: Why Scale-Down Matters

blocks.zh: Scale-down 代表性就像是跑步訓練中的「模擬賽道」。正式比賽是 2000L，但你需要在 200L 或 500L 的「縮小版賽道」上先練習、優化參數。如果供應商沒有可靠的 scale-down 模型，你就無法在生產規模上線前有效地開發和轉移製程。
blocks.en: Scale-down representativeness is like a "practice track" in running training. The real race is 2000 L, but you first need to practice and optimize parameters on a "scaled-down track" of 200 L or 500 L. If the vendor has no reliable scale-down model, you cannot effectively develop and transfer the process before production scale goes live.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：平台統一化
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Platform Standardization

blocks.zh: CDMO 在評選 SUB 時，除 GSK 列出的標準外，還應特別考量：
blocks.en: When selecting an SUB, a CDMO should also consider the following, beyond the criteria GSK listed:

blocks.zh: 多客戶兼容性：同一 SUB 平台能否支援不同 MAb、重組蛋白、基因治療等製程？
blocks.en: Multi-client compatibility: can the same SUB platform support different MAb, recombinant protein, gene therapy and other processes?

blocks.zh: 法規支持文件：供應商能否提供充足的 E&L（浸出物與可萃取物）數據包以支持多個 IND？
blocks.en: Regulatory support documentation: can the vendor provide an adequate E&L (extractables and leachables) data package to support multiple INDs?

blocks.zh: 全球供應一致性：如果 CDMO 在台灣或亞洲有廠，供應商的在地支援能力至關重要
blocks.en: Consistency of global supply: if the CDMO has sites in Taiwan or elsewhere in Asia, the vendor's local support capability is critical

blocks.zh: 9.2.2.1–9.2.2.3 Blend Time, kLa, and CO₂ Stripping（混合時間、kLa 與 CO₂ 去除）
blocks.en: 9.2.2.1–9.2.2.3 Blend Time, kLa, and CO₂ Stripping

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三大流體動力學測試
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Key Fluid Dynamics Tests

blocks.zh: 這三個測試構成了生物反應器物理性能評估的核心三角：
blocks.en: These three tests form the core triangle of the physical performance assessment of a bioreactor:

blocks.zh: 混合時間 (Blend Time)：評估攪拌效率——培養基中的 pH 調節劑、消泡劑、葡萄糖進料能否快速均勻分布。量測方法是追蹤酸性示蹤劑的分散時間。
blocks.en: Blend time: evaluates mixing efficiency, that is, whether pH adjusting agents, antifoam and glucose feed in the medium can be distributed quickly and uniformly. It is measured by tracking the dispersion time of an acid tracer.

blocks.zh: kLa（氧質量傳遞係數）：描述氧氣從氣泡進入液相的效率。kLa 越高，細胞在高密度培養時越不容易缺氧。
blocks.en: kLa (oxygen mass transfer coefficient): describes how efficiently oxygen moves from the gas bubbles into the liquid phase. The higher the kLa, the less likely the cells are to become oxygen-limited in high-density culture.

blocks.zh: CO₂ 去除效率：細胞代謝產生的 CO₂ 若無法有效移除，會導致培養液 pH 失控、細胞毒性上升。這是 SUB（尤其大規模）的已知弱點之一。
blocks.en: CO₂ stripping efficiency: if the CO₂ produced by cell metabolism is not removed effectively, the culture pH goes out of control and cytotoxicity rises. This is one of the known weaknesses of SUBs, especially at large scale.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：量測位置的雙點設計
blocks.en: Key Point: The Two-Point Measurement Design

blocks.zh: 所有測試都在「槽底切線處」和「液面下方」兩個位置量測，這是為了評估空間均勻性——大型反應器（尤其 2000L）的 dead zone（死角）問題比小型更嚴重。若兩點讀數差異大，代表混合不均，對 pH probe 和 DO probe 的讀值準確性都有影響。
blocks.en: All tests were measured at two locations, "the tangent at the tank bottom" and "below the liquid surface", in order to assess spatial uniformity. Dead zones are a bigger problem in large bioreactors (especially 2000 L) than in small ones. A large difference between the two readings indicates uneven mixing, which affects the accuracy of both pH probe and DO probe readings.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：kLa 的直覺理解
blocks.en: Analogy: An Intuitive View of kLa

blocks.zh: kLa 就像一個城市的「物流效率指標」——氧氣是貨物，細胞是工廠，氣泡是運輸工具。kLa 高代表物流快、工廠不缺原料；kLa 低代表物流擁塞，工廠運轉受限。大型 SUB 的挑戰在於，體積增大後氣泡需要更長的上升路徑，kLa 可能下降，必須透過 sparger 設計補償。
blocks.en: kLa is like a city's "logistics efficiency index": oxygen is the cargo, cells are the factory and bubbles are the transport vehicles. A high kLa means fast logistics and a factory that never runs short of raw material; a low kLa means congested logistics and a constrained factory. The challenge for a large SUB is that as volume increases, bubbles need a longer rise path and kLa may fall, so the sparger design must compensate.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在 scale-up 從 200L 到 2000L 時，kLa 通常會如何變化？你會如何調整操作條件來補償？
blocks.en: When scaling up from 200 L to 2000 L, how does kLa usually change? How would you adjust operating conditions to compensate?

blocks.zh: CO₂ 去除不足會如何影響 pH probe 讀值？對細胞的代謝有什麼直接後果？
blocks.en: How does insufficient CO₂ stripping affect pH probe readings? What are the direct consequences for cell metabolism?

blocks.zh: 9.2.2.4–9.2.2.6 Results, CFD, and Cell Performance（結果、CFD 與細胞性能）
blocks.en: 9.2.2.4–9.2.2.6 Results, CFD, and Cell Performance

blocks.zh: 核心概念：外推至 2000L 的方法論
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Methodology for Extrapolating to 2000 L

blocks.zh: 由於直接在 2000L 做測試成本極高，GSK 採用「小規模測試 + CFD 外推」的組合策略：
blocks.en: Because testing directly at 2000 L is very costly, GSK used a combined strategy of "small-scale testing plus CFD extrapolation":

blocks.zh: 實驗數據（200–1000L）建立 kLa 與 CO₂ 的相關性方程式
blocks.en: Experimental data (200–1000 L) establish the correlation equations for kLa and CO₂

blocks.zh: CFD 模型（3–500 萬個網格單元）預測 2000L 行為，並以小規模實驗數據驗證模型準確性
blocks.en: The CFD model (3–5 million mesh cells) predicts 2000 L behavior, and its accuracy is verified against the small-scale experimental data

blocks.zh: 兩者互為驗證，降低全規模測試的風險
blocks.en: The two verify each other, lowering the risk of full-scale testing

blocks.zh: Sparger 設計是 kLa 差異的主因——孔徑大小、孔數、分布位置決定氣泡大小和質量傳遞面積。這對 SUB 的採購決策有直接指導意義。
blocks.en: Sparger design is the main cause of kLa differences: pore size, number of pores and placement determine bubble size and mass transfer area. This directly informs SUB purchasing decisions.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：pH Probe 失效的系統性含義
blocks.en: Key Point: The Systemic Implication of the pH Probe Failure

blocks.zh: Reactor B 因 pH probe 失效導致一次試驗數據不可用——這不只是個設備故障，而是揭示了 SUB 一次性探針可靠性的系統性風險。在不鏽鋼系統中，probe 可以多次校準和更換；在 SUB 中，探針通常是隨 bag 預裝的，失效就必須整體更換。
blocks.en: In Reactor B, a pH probe failure made the data from one run unusable. This is not just an equipment fault; it reveals a systemic risk in the reliability of single-use probes in SUBs. In a stainless steel system, a probe can be calibrated and replaced many times; in an SUB, the probe is usually pre-installed with the bag, so a failure means replacing the whole assembly.

blocks.zh: 這也說明為什麼 pH probe 和 DO probe 的確效測試在 SUB 的 IQ/OQ 中至關重要。
blocks.en: This also explains why validation testing of the pH probe and DO probe is critical in the IQ/OQ of an SUB.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：CFD 就像飛行模擬器
blocks.en: Analogy: CFD Is Like a Flight Simulator

blocks.zh: 飛行員在真正駕駛飛機前，先在模擬器中練習各種情境。CFD 對 2000L SUB 的作用相同——在真實設備採購安裝前，用電腦模擬出流體行為，預見可能的 dead zone 和混合問題。網格越細（1–2 cm），模擬越精確，但計算時間也越長。
blocks.en: Before flying a real aircraft, pilots practice various scenarios in a simulator. CFD plays the same role for a 2000 L SUB: before the real equipment is purchased and installed, a computer simulates the fluid behavior to foresee possible dead zones and mixing problems. The finer the mesh (1–2 cm), the more accurate the simulation, but the longer the computing time.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：選型決策的法規可辯護性
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Regulatory Defensibility of the Selection Decision

blocks.zh: GSK 的加權評分系統設計值得 CDMO 借鑑：
blocks.en: GSK's weighted scoring system design is worth borrowing for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 決策過程有書面記錄，客戶審計或法規查廠時可展示「如何選到這個供應商」
blocks.en: The decision process is documented, so in a client audit or regulatory inspection you can show "how we came to select this vendor"

blocks.zh: 細胞性能數據直接與現有 SS 系統比較，為技術轉移提供橋接數據（bridging data）
blocks.en: Cell performance data are compared directly with the existing SS system, providing bridging data for technology transfer

blocks.zh: CFD 外推方法可作為 scale-up 確效策略的科學依據，減少法規提問
blocks.en: The CFD extrapolation method can serve as the scientific basis of a scale-up validation strategy, reducing regulatory questions

blocks.zh: 9.2.3 Vendor Comparison Overview（供應商比較概覽）
blocks.en: 9.2.3 Vendor Comparison Overview

blocks.zh: 核心概念：加權評分的三大最高權重
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Highest Weights in the Weighted Scoring

blocks.zh: 三個最高權重項目的選擇背後有清晰的業務邏輯：
blocks.en: There is clear business logic behind the choice of the three highest-weighted items:

blocks.zh: 細胞性能：最終決定產品品質和產量，直接影響業務成敗
blocks.en: Cell performance: ultimately determines product quality and yield, and directly decides business success or failure

blocks.zh: Mixing/kLa：是細胞性能的工程基礎，kLa 不足 = 細胞缺氧 = 性能下降，是可預測的失敗路徑
blocks.en: Mixing/kLa: the engineering foundation of cell performance; insufficient kLa = oxygen-starved cells = reduced performance, a predictable path to failure

blocks.zh: 供應商供應鏈：SUB bag 是專有耗材，供應中斷 = 整個平台停擺，業務風險極高
blocks.en: Vendor supply chain: SUB bags are proprietary consumables, and a supply interruption = the whole platform stops, a very high business risk

blocks.zh: 「供應商支援」權重最低——因為這是可以通過合約和培訓彌補的，而細胞性能和供應鏈是根本性的、難以事後彌補的。
blocks.en: "Vendor support" carries the lowest weight because it can be compensated for through contracts and training, whereas cell performance and supply chain are fundamental and hard to remedy after the fact.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：地區支援的不對稱性
blocks.en: Key Point: The Asymmetry of Regional Support

blocks.zh: Reactor A 在 US 得 5 分、UK 得 1 分——這提示了跨國公司或全球 CDMO 在選型時必須考量全球支援網絡的一致性，而非只看主要市場的服務水平。供應商在特定地區的代理商能力、倉儲位置、技術支援響應時間，都應納入評估。
blocks.en: Reactor A scored 5 in the US but 1 in the UK. This shows that a multinational company or global CDMO must consider the consistency of the global support network when selecting equipment, rather than looking only at the service level in the main market. The vendor's local agent capability, warehouse location and technical support response time in each region should all be part of the assessment.

blocks.zh: 如果你是一家台灣的 CDMO 要導入 2000L SUB，你會在 GSK 的評分標準上增加或調整哪些權重？為什麼？
blocks.en: If you were a CDMO in Taiwan introducing a 2000 L SUB, which weights would you add or adjust in GSK's scoring criteria, and why?

blocks.zh: 如何確保加權評分系統的客觀性，避免「已有傾向」的評估者影響結果？
blocks.en: How do you ensure the objectivity of a weighted scoring system and prevent evaluators with a pre-existing preference from influencing the result?

blocks.zh: 9.3 Installation in an Existing GMP Facility（在既有 GMP 設施中安裝）
blocks.en: 9.3 Installation in an Existing GMP Facility

blocks.zh: 核心概念：既有設施翻新的空間制約
blocks.en: Core Concept: Space Constraints in Renovating an Existing Facility

blocks.zh: UM-38 的建築結構帶來了典型的既有設施挑戰：
blocks.en: The building structure of UM-38 presents the typical challenges of an existing facility:

blocks.zh: 有效淨高：名目層高 16 ft，扣除建築結構鋼 2 ft = 可用 14 ft；再扣除製程天花板（9–10 ft），管道夾層只有 4–5 ft。2000L SUB 的高度通常超過 10 ft，需要特殊空間（high hat area）
blocks.en: Effective clear height: nominal floor-to-floor height is 16 ft; deducting 2 ft of structural steel leaves 14 ft usable; deducting the process ceiling (9–10 ft) leaves only 4–5 ft of interstitial space for piping. A 2000 L SUB is usually taller than 10 ft and needs a special space (a high hat area)

blocks.zh: High hat area（突出天花區域）：專為大型設備預留的局部加高空間，是既有廠改造時的關鍵設計資產
blocks.en: High hat area: a locally raised space reserved for large equipment, and a key design asset when retrofitting an existing plant

blocks.zh: Unidirectional flow（單向流動線）：操作人員和物料從潔淨走廊進入，廢棄物和人員從回廊離開——翻新期間必須維持這個邏輯
blocks.en: Unidirectional flow: operators and materials enter from the clean corridor, and waste and personnel leave via the return corridor. This logic must be maintained during the renovation

blocks.zh: 重點提示：翻新期間的 GMP 控制
blocks.en: Key Point: GMP Controls During Renovation

blocks.zh: 施工期間以塑料遮蔽板（plastic sheathing）封閉潔淨走廊入口——這是典型的「軟隔離」措施。其核心原則是：建設動線（施工人員、廢棄建材）與生產動線（操作人員、物料）必須嚴格分離，同時保留緊急出口通道。在現實 GMP 環境中，這種同步翻新需要詳細的 CCR（建設合規性審查）和持續的環境監測。
blocks.en: During construction, the entrance to the clean corridor was closed off with plastic sheathing, a typical "soft segregation" measure. The core principle is that the construction flow (construction workers, waste building materials) and the production flow (operators, materials) must be strictly separated, while emergency egress is preserved. In a real GMP environment, this kind of concurrent renovation requires a detailed CCR (construction compliance review) and continuous environmental monitoring.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：現有廠房改造評估
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Assessing an Existing Plant for Retrofit

blocks.zh: 在評估既有廠房是否適合安裝大型 SUB 時，應優先確認：
blocks.en: When assessing whether an existing plant is suitable for installing a large SUB, first confirm:

blocks.zh: 是否有 high hat area 可利用，或改造成本是否在預算內
blocks.en: Whether a high hat area is available, or whether the cost of creating one is within budget

blocks.zh: 回廊空間是否足以同時作為施工通道而不影響相鄰生產區
blocks.en: Whether the return corridor has enough space to serve as a construction route without affecting adjacent production areas

blocks.zh: WFI 和清潔蒸汽的管路是否有容量裕量支持新增設備
blocks.en: Whether the WFI and clean steam piping has the capacity margin to support the additional equipment

blocks.zh: BAS（Building Automation System）是否有空餘控制點整合新設備
blocks.en: Whether the BAS (Building Automation System) has spare control points to integrate the new equipment

blocks.zh: 9.3.3–9.3.4 Suite 1 Renovation and Hybrid Approach（Suite 1 翻新與混合策略）
blocks.en: 9.3.3–9.3.4 Suite 1 Renovation and Hybrid Approach

blocks.zh: 核心概念：翻新中的空間優化決策
blocks.en: Core Concept: Space Optimization Decisions in the Renovation

blocks.zh: Suite 1 翻新的幾個關鍵設計決策值得深入分析：
blocks.en: Several key design decisions in the Suite 1 renovation merit closer analysis:

blocks.zh: 選擇 750L 位置安裝 2000L SUB：利用現有 high hat，避免天花板大改。這是「最小干擾、最大利用」的設計思路
blocks.en: Installing the 2000 L SUB in the 750 L position: uses the existing high hat and avoids major ceiling changes. This is a "minimum disruption, maximum use" design approach

blocks.zh: 保留 1200L SS 反應器：作為長期性能比較的基準（control），同時也提供了業務連續性的安全網
blocks.en: Retaining the 1200 L SS bioreactor: serves as a benchmark (control) for long-term performance comparison, and also provides a business continuity safety net

blocks.zh: 收穫槽從 1500L → 2500L：下游設備必須跟上游的工作體積匹配，這是設備整合設計中容易被忽視的細節
blocks.en: Harvest tank from 1500 L to 2500 L: downstream equipment must match the upstream working volume, a detail that is easily overlooked in equipment integration design

blocks.zh: 核心概念：不鏽鋼與一次性混合策略
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Stainless Steel and Single-Use Hybrid Strategy

blocks.zh: Hybrid approach 的核心邏輯：當一次性系統在特定操作（粉末加料）帶來過大的設施改造成本時，保留不鏽鋼系統是理性的選擇。
blocks.en: The core logic of the hybrid approach: when a single-use system would require excessive facility modification cost for a particular operation (powder addition), keeping the stainless steel system is a rational choice.

blocks.zh: 混合策略的成功前提是：既有不鏽鋼系統具備 CIP/SIP 能力，可以清潔和滅菌與新一次性系統的接口。這使得兩個系統能安全整合。
blocks.en: The hybrid strategy depends on one precondition: the existing stainless steel system has CIP/SIP capability, so the interface with the new single-use system can be cleaned and sterilized. This allows the two systems to be integrated safely.

blocks.zh: 這個案例說明：「一次性化」不是「全面替換」，而是「在對的地方用對的技術」。
blocks.en: This case shows that "going single-use" does not mean "replacing everything", but "using the right technology in the right place".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：混合策略就像廚房改裝
blocks.en: Analogy: The Hybrid Strategy Is Like a Kitchen Refit

blocks.zh: 想像你要改裝一個商業廚房——你不需要把所有設備都換新，而是把最需要靈活性的工作站（一次性技術）換掉，但保留大型固定設備（工業烤箱、中央排水）。關鍵是讓新舊設備能無縫接軌，食材能順暢從一個工作站流到下一個。媒體轉移管路就是廚房裡的「傳菜系統」。
blocks.en: Imagine refitting a commercial kitchen. You do not need to replace all the equipment; you replace the workstations that most need flexibility (single-use technology) but keep the large fixed equipment (industrial ovens, central drainage). The key is that old and new equipment connect seamlessly so ingredients flow smoothly from one station to the next. The media transfer piping is the kitchen's "order pass-through system".

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：混合系統的 GMP 影響
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: GMP Impact of a Hybrid System

blocks.zh: 混合系統在 GMP 文件和確效上帶來額外挑戰：
blocks.en: A hybrid system brings additional challenges to GMP documentation and validation:

blocks.zh: 不鏽鋼-一次性接口需要明確定義「清潔邊界」和「無菌邊界」
blocks.en: The stainless steel-single-use interface needs a clearly defined "cleaning boundary" and "sterile boundary"

blocks.zh: 一次性系統的完整性測試（integrity test）必須納入批次記錄
blocks.en: Integrity testing of the single-use system must be included in the batch record

blocks.zh: 現有 SS 管路的 CIP 確效是否仍然有效？需要評估改造對清潔效果的影響
blocks.en: Is the CIP validation of the existing SS piping still valid? The impact of the modification on cleaning effectiveness needs to be assessed

blocks.zh: 混合系統的 IQ/OQ 範圍界定：哪些部分屬於新設備確效，哪些屬於既有系統再確效？
blocks.en: Scoping the IQ/OQ of a hybrid system: which parts fall under new equipment qualification, and which under requalification of the existing system?

blocks.zh: 9.3.5–9.3.7 Project Schedule, Support, and Phase II（專案進度、支援與第二階段）
blocks.en: 9.3.5–9.3.7 Project Schedule, Support, and Phase II

blocks.zh: 核心概念：24 個月的時程管理
blocks.en: Core Concept: Managing a 24-Month Schedule

blocks.zh: 技術選定到完成安裝共 24 個月，這個數字對規劃類似項目的人很有參考意義：
blocks.en: From technology selection to completion of installation took 24 months, a figure that is a useful reference for anyone planning a similar project:

blocks.zh: 早期採購設備（Early procurement）是縮短工期的關鍵——SUB 設備的 lead time 可達 6–12 個月，若晚了就會成為關鍵路徑瓶頸
blocks.en: Early procurement of equipment is the key to shortening the schedule: SUB equipment lead times can reach 6–12 months, and any delay becomes a critical-path bottleneck

blocks.zh: 非 GMP 區域預先測試混合系統：先「空跑」再安裝，避免在 GMP 區域發現問題後的昂貴返工
blocks.en: Pre-testing the mixing system in a non-GMP area: do a "dry run" first and install afterwards, avoiding costly rework if problems are found in the GMP area

blocks.zh: 媒體配製區優先完工：確保能支持 Suite II 的持續生產——這是業務連續性優先於施工方便性的決策
blocks.en: Completing the media preparation area first: ensures continued production support for Suite II, a decision that puts business continuity ahead of construction convenience

blocks.zh: 重點提示：確效人力的隱性成本
blocks.en: Key Point: The Hidden Cost of Validation Manpower

blocks.zh: 專案峰值需要 25 人的內部支援——注意原文特別指出，一次性系統的確效協議開發比不鏽鋼系統需要更多人力，因為沒有現成的 SOP 和協議可直接沿用。
blocks.en: The project peak required 25 people of internal support. Note that the source specifically states that developing validation protocols for a single-use system required more manpower than for a stainless steel system, because there were no ready-made SOPs and protocols that could be reused directly.

blocks.zh: 這是許多機構在評估 SUB 導入成本時低估的隱性成本：確效文件的從零開發、新操作 SOP 的撰寫與審查、人員培訓計畫的設計——這些都需要品質、工程和生產部門的大量投入。
blocks.en: This is a hidden cost that many organizations underestimate when assessing the cost of SUB adoption: developing validation documents from scratch, writing and reviewing new operating SOPs, and designing training programs all require substantial input from Quality, Engineering and Production.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Phase II 的設計改進——平台的誕生
blocks.en: Core Concept: Phase II Design Improvements - The Birth of the Platform

blocks.zh: Phase I 沒有操作平台，Phase II 根據經驗教訓增加了圍繞 2000L SUB 的操作平台：
blocks.en: Phase I had no operating platform; Phase II added an operating platform around the 2000 L SUB based on lessons learned:

blocks.zh: 功能：提供進入反應器頂部的通道（安裝過濾器、培養基轉移連接）
blocks.en: Function: provides access to the top of the bioreactor (installing filters, media transfer connections)

blocks.zh: 尺寸設計：平台下方淨高 6 ft 8 in（允許操作人員在反應器後方通行）；平台上方到建築鋼材 13 ft 9 in（剛好在 14 ft 限制內）
blocks.en: Dimensional design: clear height beneath the platform is 6 ft 8 in (allowing operators to pass behind the bioreactor); the height from the platform to the building steel is 13 ft 9 in (just within the 14 ft limit)

blocks.zh: 額外效益：平台下方空間可安裝控制系統，充分利用垂直空間
blocks.en: Additional benefit: the space beneath the platform can house the control system, making full use of the vertical space

blocks.zh: 這個改進說明了「第一次建設不一定能預見所有操作需求」，預留改進空間和記錄問題的 AAR 機制才是關鍵。
blocks.en: This improvement shows that "the first build cannot always foresee every operating need", and that leaving room for improvement and an AAR mechanism to record issues is what matters.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：人力規劃與時程估算
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Manpower Planning and Schedule Estimation

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 管理層的建議：
blocks.en: Recommendations for CDMO management:

blocks.zh: 新技術導入的確效人力需求比設備更換多 30–50%，需提前進行人力規劃
blocks.en: The validation manpower required to introduce a new technology is 30–50% higher than for an equipment replacement, so plan manpower early

blocks.zh: 考慮僱用具有 SUB 確效經驗的外部顧問（如 Hargrove Life Sciences 在此案例中的角色），加速文件開發
blocks.en: Consider hiring external consultants with SUB validation experience (such as the role of Hargrove Life Sciences in this case) to speed up document development

blocks.zh: 24 個月的基準時程應作為最樂觀估算——複雜 CDMO 環境（多客戶、多產品）的並行管理可能使時程延長至 30–36 個月
blocks.en: The 24-month baseline schedule should be treated as the most optimistic estimate; the parallel management required in a complex CDMO environment (multiple clients, multiple products) may extend the schedule to 30–36 months

blocks.zh: 9.4 Project Risks and Mitigation — New Technology（專案風險與緩解——新技術）
blocks.en: 9.4 Project Risks and Mitigation - New Technology

blocks.zh: 核心概念：一次性技術的三大新風險類別
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three New Risk Categories of Single-Use Technology

blocks.zh: 從不鏽鋼轉向一次性技術，風險模式發生根本性轉變：
blocks.en: Moving from stainless steel to single-use technology fundamentally changes the risk pattern:

blocks.zh: 操作性風險：手動連接（aseptic connection）的技術門檻高，人員技能差異直接導致品質風險。不鏽鋼系統的 CIP/SIP 相對標準化，一次性系統更依賴人的判斷和技巧。
blocks.en: Operational risk: manual (aseptic) connections have a high skill threshold, and differences in operator skill translate directly into quality risk. CIP/SIP in stainless steel systems is relatively standardized, whereas single-use systems depend more on human judgment and technique.

blocks.zh: 供應鏈風險：SUB bag 是專有耗材，供應商停產、品質問題或天災可直接導致生產停擺。不鏽鋼的「設備」壽命可達 20 年，bag 的「庫存」週期只有數月。
blocks.en: Supply chain risk: SUB bags are proprietary consumables, and a supplier discontinuing production, a quality problem or a natural disaster can stop production directly. Stainless steel "equipment" can last 20 years, while bag "inventory" lasts only a few months.

blocks.zh: 庫存管理風險：bag 有有效期，過期即廢；bag 體積大，倉儲成本高；需求預測不準確會導致批次延遲或浪費。
blocks.en: Inventory management risk: bags have expiry dates and are scrapped once expired; bags are bulky, so storage costs are high; inaccurate demand forecasting leads to batch delays or waste.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：FMEA 的執行時機
blocks.en: Key Point: When to Perform the FMEA

blocks.zh: 在 SUT 導入中，FMEA 應在工程確效（EQ）之前完成，並作為確效測試設計的依據——哪些失敗模式最關鍵（RPN 最高），就對應哪些確效測試項目。原文提到的 FMEA 範疇覆蓋「設備」和「操作 SOP」，這是完整的視角：設備失效 + 人員失誤都要納入。
blocks.en: In an SUT implementation, the FMEA should be completed before engineering qualification (EQ) and used as the basis for designing the qualification tests: the most critical failure modes (highest RPN) map to the corresponding qualification test items. The FMEA scope in the source covers both "equipment" and "operating SOPs", which is a complete view: equipment failure and human error must both be included.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：標準化管路集的設計哲學
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Design Philosophy of Standardized Tubing Sets

blocks.zh: Process flow map 的設計目標是「共用管路集」而非「每步驟專用」——這是降低 SKU 複雜度的關鍵策略：
blocks.en: The design goal of the process flow map is "shared tubing sets" rather than "dedicated to each step", a key strategy for reducing SKU complexity:

blocks.zh: 減少庫存管理條目數量，降低誤用錯誤風險
blocks.en: Reduces the number of inventory items and lowers the risk of misuse errors

blocks.zh: 提高採購議價能力（更大的批量訂購）
blocks.en: Improves purchasing negotiating power (larger order quantities)

blocks.zh: 簡化操作培訓（相同的管路配置，操作人員只需學習一套技能）
blocks.en: Simplifies operator training (with the same tubing configuration, operators need to learn only one set of skills)

blocks.zh: 這個「標準化」思路在 CDMO 環境中尤為重要，因為 CDMO 服務多個客戶，若每個客戶都有不同的管路規格，庫存管理會失控。
blocks.en: This standardization approach is especially important in a CDMO environment: a CDMO serves multiple clients, and if every client has a different tubing specification, inventory management gets out of control.

blocks.zh: 在你的現有製程中，如果要引入一次性轉移系統，你認為 FMEA 中 RPN 最高的失敗模式會是什麼？如何緩解？
blocks.en: If you were to introduce a single-use transfer system into your current process, what do you think the failure mode with the highest RPN in the FMEA would be? How would you mitigate it?

blocks.zh: 「共用管路集」策略在多客戶 CDMO 中如何實施？你會如何在客戶定制需求和標準化之間取得平衡？
blocks.en: How would the "shared tubing set" strategy be implemented in a multi-client CDMO? How would you balance customer-specific requirements against standardization?

blocks.zh: 9.5 Vendor Supply Chain（供應商供應鏈）
blocks.en: 9.5 Vendor Supply Chain

blocks.zh: 核心概念：供應鏈的層次解析
blocks.en: Core Concept: Layers of the Supply Chain

blocks.zh: 原文區分了兩個供應鏈層次，各有不同風險：
blocks.en: The source distinguishes two supply chain layers, each with different risks:

blocks.zh: 通用耗材（管路）：可多供應商採購，風險低——這是 commoditized 市場
blocks.en: Generic consumables (tubing): can be sourced from multiple suppliers, low risk; this is a commoditized market

blocks.zh: SUB bag（專有耗材）
blocks.en: SUB bags (proprietary consumables)

blocks.zh: ：供應商鎖定（lock-in），需深度管理：
blocks.en: : vendor lock-in, requiring in-depth management:

blocks.zh: Bag film 原料：供應商是否有獨家供應商？
blocks.en: Bag film raw material: does the film have a sole-source supplier?

blocks.zh: 備用製造廠：主廠出問題時，備廠是否已驗證？
blocks.en: Backup manufacturing site: if the main site has a problem, has the backup site already been qualified?

blocks.zh: 輻照場地：bag 的 gamma 輻照通常需要外包，備用輻照場地是否存在？
blocks.en: Irradiation sites: gamma irradiation of bags is usually outsourced; does a backup irradiation site exist?

blocks.zh: 運輸協議：大型 bag 的包裝、溫度控制、運輸時間——尤其對台灣等需進口耗材的地區
blocks.en: Shipping agreement: packaging, temperature control and transit time for large bags, especially for regions such as Taiwan that must import consumables

blocks.zh: 重點提示：供應鏈風險的「聯合識別」
blocks.en: Key Point: Joint Identification of Supply Chain Risks

blocks.zh: 原文特別強調 Single point of failure 應與供應商「共同」識別（jointly），而非單方面評估。這個做法很重要：供應商對自己供應鏈的了解遠超過客戶，許多風險點只有在深度合作中才能揭露。這也是為什麼 SUT 供應商管理比傳統設備供應商管理更接近「合作夥伴關係」而非純粹的「採購關係」。
blocks.en: The source specifically emphasizes that single points of failure should be identified jointly with the vendor, rather than assessed unilaterally. This practice matters: the vendor knows its own supply chain far better than the customer, and many risk points are revealed only through deep collaboration. This is also why SUT vendor management is closer to a "partnership" than a purely "purchasing relationship", compared with traditional equipment vendor management.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Bag 庫存管理就像血庫管理
blocks.en: Analogy: Bag Inventory Management Is Like Blood Bank Management

blocks.zh: 醫院血庫需要維持足夠的血液存量，但血液有保存期限，存太多會浪費、存太少會在緊急手術時斷貨。SUB bag 的庫存管理邏輯相同：需要根據生產計畫預測用量、考慮 lead time 設定安全庫存、定期輪替以避免過期。差別在於，血型種類有限，而 CDMO 可能同時管理不同客戶、不同大小的 bag，複雜度更高。
blocks.en: A hospital blood bank must keep enough blood in stock, but blood has a shelf life: too much is wasted, and too little means a shortage during emergency surgery. SUB bag inventory management follows the same logic: forecast usage from the production plan, set safety stock allowing for lead time, and rotate stock regularly to avoid expiry. The difference is that there are only a limited number of blood types, whereas a CDMO may manage bags of different sizes for different clients at the same time, so the complexity is higher.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：供應鏈韌性設計
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Designing Supply Chain Resilience

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，建立 SUB 供應鏈韌性的實際步驟：
blocks.en: Practical steps for a CDMO to build SUB supply chain resilience:

blocks.zh: 供應商資格審計：要求 SUB 供應商提交 Business Continuity Plan（業務連續性計畫），並在供應協議中載明備用方案
blocks.en: Supplier qualification audit: require the SUB vendor to submit a Business Continuity Plan, and state the contingency arrangements in the supply agreement

blocks.zh: 雙供應商策略：如果技術平台允許，考慮認證第二家供應商的 bag（可能需要重新做 E&L 和細胞相容性測試）
blocks.en: Dual-supplier strategy: if the technology platform allows, consider qualifying bags from a second supplier (E&L and cell compatibility testing may need to be repeated)

blocks.zh: ERP 整合：將 bag 的批號、到期日、庫存量納入 ERP 系統自動追蹤，設定安全庫存警示
blocks.en: ERP integration: track bag lot numbers, expiry dates and stock levels automatically in the ERP system, and set safety stock alerts

blocks.zh: 客戶溝通：在 CMO 合約中明確規定 bag 供應中斷的通知義務和協議機制
blocks.en: Customer communication: specify in the CMO contract the notification obligations and agreed mechanisms for a bag supply interruption

blocks.zh: 9.6 Application of Lessons Learned（經驗教訓應用）
blocks.en: 9.6 Application of Lessons Learned

blocks.zh: 核心概念：AAR 的結構化學習機制
blocks.en: Core Concept: AAR as a Structured Learning Mechanism

blocks.zh: After Action Review (AAR) 是源自軍事訓練的結構化反思工具，在製藥項目管理中的應用越來越普遍。GSK 的 AAR 成果揭示了一個重要的洞察：
blocks.en: After Action Review (AAR) is a structured reflection tool that originated in military training and is increasingly common in pharmaceutical project management. GSK's AAR results reveal an important insight:

blocks.zh: 60% 溝通問題：這在大型跨部門專案中非常典型——技術問題通常只占少數，人員協調才是最大挑戰
blocks.en: 60% communication issues: very typical of large cross-functional projects; technical problems are usually a minority, and people coordination is the biggest challenge

blocks.zh: 30% 文件問題：SUT 專案的文件密度遠高於傳統設備替換，文件節奏管理（staggering）至關重要
blocks.en: 30% documentation issues: the documentation density of an SUT project is far higher than that of a traditional equipment replacement, so managing the pace of documents (staggering) is critical

blocks.zh: 10% 安裝問題：包括耗材初始估算嚴重不足——這是一次性技術的新手陷阱
blocks.en: 10% installation issues: including a serious underestimate of consumables at the outset, a rookie trap of single-use technology

blocks.zh: 這個 60/30/10 的比例對規劃類似專案有很強的指導意義：投入資源的優先級應該是溝通 > 文件 > 技術。
blocks.en: This 60/30/10 split is a strong guide for planning similar projects: the priority for resources should be communication > documentation > technology.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：確效耗材估算的「首次效應」
blocks.en: Key Point: The "First-Time Effect" in Estimating Validation Consumables

blocks.zh: 「安裝期間的一次性耗材需求遠超預期」是 SUT 新手的普遍教訓。原因：
blocks.en: "Single-use consumable demand during installation far exceeds expectations" is a common lesson for SUT newcomers. The reasons:

blocks.zh: 每一次確效測試（IQ/OQ/PQ）都需要新的 bag 和管路集
blocks.en: Every validation test (IQ/OQ/PQ) requires new bags and tubing sets

blocks.zh: 失敗的測試批次需要重複，耗材加倍消耗
blocks.en: Failed test runs must be repeated, doubling consumable use

blocks.zh: 操作培訓需要練習用耗材，不能全部算入確效計劃
blocks.en: Operator training needs practice consumables, which cannot all be counted in the validation plan

blocks.zh: 建議：首次 SUB 導入時，耗材採購量應比計算值高出 50–100%，並保持採購彈性。
blocks.en: Recommendation: for a first SUB implementation, the quantity of consumables purchased should be 50–100% higher than calculated, and purchasing flexibility should be maintained.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：文件「節奏管理」就像出版截稿
blocks.en: Analogy: Document "Pacing" Is Like a Publication Deadline

blocks.zh: 想像一份月刊雜誌的編輯工作——如果所有稿件同時送達，編輯會被淹沒；如果按欄目分批送達，工作就可以有序進行。GSK 的文件節奏管理（staggering）就是這個道理：讓審查和批准者在整個項目期間保持可控的工作量，而非在截止日前堆積成山。
blocks.en: Think of the editorial work on a monthly magazine: if all manuscripts arrive at once, the editors are overwhelmed; if they arrive in batches by section, the work proceeds in an orderly way. GSK's document pacing (staggering) follows the same logic: keep the workload of reviewers and approvers manageable throughout the project, rather than letting it pile up in a mountain before the deadline.

blocks.zh: 在你參與過的大型專案中，問題的主要類別是什麼？是否也符合「溝通 > 文件 > 技術」的分布模式？
blocks.en: In a large project you have taken part in, what were the main categories of problems? Did they also fit the "communication > documentation > technology" pattern?

blocks.zh: 如果你要為一個 SUB 導入專案設計 AAR 機制，你會選擇什麼時間點執行 AAR？每個階段結束後，還是整個專案完成後？兩種做法各有什麼優劣？
blocks.en: If you were designing an AAR mechanism for an SUB implementation project, at what points would you run the AAR: at the end of each phase, or after the whole project is completed? What are the advantages and disadvantages of each approach?

blocks.zh: 9.7 Conclusions（結論）
blocks.en: 9.7 Conclusions

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「看似更簡單」的陷阱
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Trap of "Seemingly Simpler"

blocks.zh: 結論中最值得注意的洞察："Single-use technologies, though appearing inherently simpler than stainless steel systems, present new challenges..."
blocks.en: The most noteworthy insight in the conclusions: "Single-use technologies, though appearing inherently simpler than stainless steel systems, present new challenges..."

blocks.zh: 這句話打破了「一次性 = 簡單」的常見誤解。不鏽鋼的複雜性集中在設備維護和 CIP/SIP 系統；一次性的複雜性分散在人員培訓、庫存管理和供應商關係管理上。前者是「工程問題」，後者是「組織問題」——很多工廠在轉型時低估了後者的難度。
blocks.en: This statement breaks the common misconception that "single-use = simple". The complexity of stainless steel is concentrated in equipment maintenance and CIP/SIP systems; the complexity of single-use is spread across personnel training, inventory management and vendor relationship management. The former is an "engineering problem", the latter an "organizational problem", and many plants underestimate the difficulty of the latter when transitioning.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：混合設計的關鍵使能因素
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Key Enabler of Hybrid Design

blocks.zh: 原文明確指出混合策略能夠成功的前提條件：既有設施具備 SIP（蒸汽就地滅菌）和 CIP（就地清洗）能力。這意味著：
blocks.en: The source states explicitly the precondition for the success of the hybrid strategy: the existing facility has SIP (steam-in-place) and CIP (clean-in-place) capability. This means:

blocks.zh: 全新建造的設施可能沒有這個條件，混合策略的適用性需要重新評估
blocks.en: A newly built facility may not have this capability, so the applicability of the hybrid strategy needs to be reassessed

blocks.zh: 現有廠房改造的優勢之一：可利用既有公用設施基礎設施，而非從零開始
blocks.en: One advantage of retrofitting an existing plant: existing utility infrastructure can be used instead of starting from scratch

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP 系統的容量和佈局在設施評估初期就需要確認
blocks.en: The capacity and layout of the CIP/SIP systems must be confirmed at the start of the facility assessment

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：案例的最終啟示
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: The Final Takeaways from the Case

blocks.zh: GSK UM-38 案例對 CDMO 的整體啟示：
blocks.en: Overall takeaways of the GSK UM-38 case for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 技術選型：用結構化的定性+定量+加權評分系統，確保決策可辯護
blocks.en: Technology selection: use a structured qualitative + quantitative + weighted scoring system to make the decision defensible

blocks.zh: 設施改造：最小化對既有系統的干擾，分階段執行，充分利用 high hat 等既有資產
blocks.en: Facility modification: minimize disruption to existing systems, execute in phases, and make full use of existing assets such as the high hat

blocks.zh: 確效：預留充足的人力和耗材預算，新技術的文件開發成本遠高於設備替換
blocks.en: Validation: allow sufficient manpower and consumables budget; the documentation development cost of a new technology is far higher than that of an equipment replacement

blocks.zh: 供應鏈：將 bag 視為「業務關鍵耗材」而非「辦公用品」，建立正式的供應商風險管理框架
blocks.en: Supply chain: treat bags as "business-critical consumables" rather than "office supplies", and establish a formal supplier risk management framework

blocks.zh: 持續改進：AAR 機制確保每個專案的學習不流失，分階段執行讓學習能被應用
blocks.en: Continuous improvement: the AAR mechanism ensures that the learning from each project is not lost, and phased execution lets the learning be applied

blocks.zh: 重點提示：性能等效的意義
blocks.en: Key Point: The Meaning of Performance Equivalence

blocks.zh: 2000L SUB 的細胞效價（titer）和產量與 1200L SS 系統相當（comparable）——注意不是「更好」，而是「相當」。這個結果在商業化決策中已足夠：能夠在更大規模、更低基礎設施成本、更高靈活性的條件下，實現與不鏽鋼相當的產品質量，正是 SUB 平台價值主張的核心。
blocks.en: The cell titer and yield of the 2000 L SUB were comparable to those of the 1200 L SS system. Note that this is "comparable", not "better". This result is sufficient for a commercial decision: achieving comparable product quality at larger scale, lower infrastructure cost and greater flexibility is the core of the SUB platform's value proposition.

blocks.zh: 附錄5 章節總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Appendix 5 Section Summary

blocks.zh: GSK 的兩階段 2000L SUB 導入是業界最具代表性的大規模一次性生物反應器實施案例，從技術選型到設施改造到供應鏈管理，提供了完整的決策框架。
blocks.en: GSK's two-phase 2000 L SUB implementation is the most representative industry example of a large-scale single-use bioreactor implementation, and provides a complete decision framework from technology selection through facility modification to supply chain management.

blocks.zh: 技術選型採用定性篩選 → 定量評估（混合時間、kLa、CO₂ 去除、細胞性能）→ 加權評分的三步驟流程，三大最高權重為：細胞性能、Mixing/kLa、供應商供應鏈。
blocks.en: Technology selection followed a three-step process of qualitative screening, then quantitative evaluation (blend time, kLa, CO₂ stripping, cell performance), then weighted scoring. The three highest weights were cell performance, Mixing/kLa and vendor supply chain.

blocks.zh: 設施改造的核心策略是：充分利用既有 high hat 空間、採用 SS + SUT 混合設計、分階段施工以維持業務連續性；Phase II 根據 Phase I 經驗增加操作平台，體現了「學習型組織」的改善機制。
blocks.en: The core strategies of facility modification were to make full use of the existing high hat space, adopt a hybrid SS + SUT design, and construct in phases to maintain business continuity; the operating platform added in Phase II based on Phase I experience reflects the improvement mechanism of a "learning organization".

blocks.zh: 風險管理工具包括：水/工程批次操作培訓、FMEA、製程流程圖（用於標準化管路集設計）。供應鏈管理需關注 bag film 來源、備用製造廠、輻照場地及運輸協議等單點失效風險。
blocks.en: Risk management tools included water/engineering batch operator training, FMEA, and the process flow map (used to design standardized tubing sets). Supply chain management must address single-point-of-failure risks such as bag film source, backup manufacturing site, irradiation sites and shipping agreements.

blocks.zh: AAR 結果顯示問題來源：溝通 60%、文件 30%、安裝 10%——提示大型 SUT 導入專案最大的挑戰是組織協調而非技術本身，耗材初始估算需預留 50–100% 的緩衝。
blocks.en: The AAR results showed the sources of problems: communication 60%, documentation 30%, installation 10%. This indicates that the biggest challenge in a large SUT implementation project is organizational coordination rather than the technology itself, and that the initial consumables estimate should include a 50–100% buffer.

blocks.zh: 最終結論：2000L SUB 實現了與 1200L SS 系統相當的細胞效價和產量；一次性技術「看似更簡單」但在操作培訓和供應商依賴上帶來新的組織挑戰；既有 CIP/SIP 基礎設施是混合設計策略可行的關鍵使能因素。
blocks.en: The final conclusion: the 2000 L SUB achieved cell titer and yield comparable to the 1200 L SS system; single-use technology is "seemingly simpler" but brings new organizational challenges in operator training and vendor dependency; existing CIP/SIP infrastructure is the key enabler that makes the hybrid design strategy feasible.
